purpose: Name-free domain contrasts frozen before source-description experiment results. Diagnostic targets, not task-success labels.

cases.zh: 我们Google Ads付费搜索账户的无效点击吃掉了预算，请分析搜索词报告，分层设计否定关键词，避免广告组相互抢流量。
cases.en: Wasted clicks are consuming our Google Ads paid-search budget. Analyze search term reports, design tiered negative keywords and stop ad groups competing for traffic.

cases.zh: 我下个月考全国计算机等级二级Python，现在循环和公共基础薄弱。请先诊断基础，再安排对应辅导和真题复习。
cases.en: I take the NCRE Level 2 Python exam next month and struggle with loops and common fundamentals. Diagnose my level, arrange targeted tutoring and past-exam revision.

cases.zh: 我还有三个月考研，每天只有晚上两小时，数学落后，英语单词总忘，请制定可调整的每日计划、复习节奏和周复盘。
cases.en: My postgraduate entrance exam is in three months. I have two evening hours daily, lag in math and forget vocabulary. Create an adjustable daily plan, spaced revision and weekly reviews.

cases.zh: 从零交付一个预约管理产品，请从需求规格开始，组织架构、交互、开发和测试角色交接，反复修复测试发现的问题，最后集成验收。
cases.en: Deliver an appointment-management product from scratch: start with requirements, coordinate architecture, UX, development and QA handoffs, iterate on test failures and finish integrated acceptance.

cases.zh: 我们的工具推荐服务一百个请求错峰进来会变慢，请做负载实验，区分编码、候选生成和排序耗时，记录吞吐、尾延迟和错误率，再验证优化。
cases.en: Our tool recommendation service slows under one hundred staggered requests. Load test it, separate encoding, candidate-generation and ranking costs, measure throughput, tail latency and errors, then validate changes.

cases.zh: 线上PostgreSQL订单表的连接查询越来越慢，请用EXPLAIN ANALYZE检查扫描、连接和索引，对同一数据验证改动并防止结果错误。
cases.en: A join against our production PostgreSQL orders table is slowing. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to examine scans, joins and indexes, validate changes on identical data and preserve result correctness.

cases.zh: 线上消息服务出现级联故障，请分配事故指挥与沟通职责，建立严重等级和恢复检查点，协调恢复并组织无责复盘。
cases.en: Cascading failures hit our production messaging service. Assign incident command and communication roles, establish severity and recovery checkpoints, coordinate restoration and conduct a blameless postmortem.

cases.zh: 比较几种电池回收工艺的污染与成本，分开调研不同来源，交叉验证冲突证据并核对引用，审阅后交付完整的研究报告。
cases.en: Compare pollution and costs of battery-recycling processes. Research independent sources, cross-check conflicting evidence and citations, review the findings and deliver a complete research report.

limitations: Queries and labels are investigator-written; this is a domain-confusion diagnostic, not independent accuracy ground truth.
Names occur only in target labels, never in retrieval inputs. Existing observed sets remain development data.
